test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She was barking up the wrong _____ when she filed a complaint against ragging with the students' union instead of the university administration.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Barking up the wrong tree**" is an idiomatic expression meaning to pursue a mistaken or misguided course of action.
 
• In this context, filing a complaint with the students' union instead of the university administration fits the expression.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Disc:** Refers to a flat, thin circular object, which is not relevant in this context.
 
• **Dog:** Does not fit as part of the idiomatic expression.
 
• **Pillar:** Refers to a tall vertical structure, which is not part of the idiom.
